subject: storing selected points and display them on an other ggvis plot

messages.author: 53fa2628863d44a6
messages.subject: storing selected points and display them on an other ggvis plot
parts:
Hi everyone,

I started to use ggvis with shiny  and I ran into a problem i can't solve for days.

I want to make an app that has 2 ggvis plot. Both of them has 2 select input (in the shiny ui) on which you can select the columns of the data frame that you want to see on the axes.
Here comes the tricky part: I want to store the selected data from the first plot, and want to display it on the second. This problem is very similar to this (https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/ggvis/shiny/ggvis/mrKW4QNNPro/0L4U1Uswe64J) but instead of a table, I want to see them on another ggvis plot.

Here is what i have so far:

ui:
shinyUI(fluidPage(
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput("xAxism",
                  label = "Select the value of axis x for the main plot",
                  colnames(observed.data.frame)),
      selectInput("yAxism",
                  label = "Select the value of axis y for the main plot",
                  colnames(observed.data.frame)),
      selectInput("xAxiss",
                  label = "Select the value of axis x for the secondary plot",
                  colnames(observed.data.frame)),
      selectInput("yAxiss",
                  label = "Select the value of axis y for the secondary plot",
                  colnames(observed.data.frame))
    ),
    mainPanel(
      ggvisOutput("ggvis_scatm"),
      ggvisOutput("ggvis_scats")
    )
  )
))

server:
library(shiny)
library(ggvis)

observed.data.frame <- mtcars

shinyServer(function(input, output) { 
  
  rvalues <- reactiveValues(selected = 0)

  vism <- reactive({
    xm <- prop("x", as.symbol(input$xAxism))
    ym <- prop("y", as.symbol(input$yAxism))
    
    observed.data.frame %>% 
    ggvis(x = xm, y = ym) %>%
    layer_points(fill.brush := "red") %>% 
    handle_brush(function(items, page_loc, session, ...) {
      rvalues$selected <<- items$keys__
    })
  })

  viss <- reactive({
    xs <- prop("x", as.symbol(input$xAxiss))
    ys <- prop("y", as.symbol(input$yAxiss))
    
    observed.data.frame[rvalues$selected,] %>% 
      ggvis(x = xs, y = ys) %>%
      layer_points()
  })  

  vism %>% bind_shiny("ggvis_scatm")
  viss %>% bind_shiny("ggvis_scats")
})

This is the ''latest version" that works. I've tried out some solutions that i've read int this group, but they didn't work. Every functionality is working properly except one: the data doesn't get "transferred" into the other plot.

Any help or advice would be highly appreciated.
Gergo

Hi again,

I've finally solved the problem. Partially. 


shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
  observed.data.frame <- mtcars
  observed.data.frame$id <- seq(1,length(observed.data.frame[,1]))
  selected_col_xm <- prop("x", as.symbol("mpg"))
  selected_col_ym <- prop("y", as.symbol("mpg"))
  selected_col_xs <- prop("x", as.symbol("mpg"))
  selected_col_ys <- prop("y", as.symbol("mpg"))
  selected_data <- data.frame()
  
  main_data <- reactive({    
    selected_col_xm <<- prop("x", as.symbol(input$xAxism))
    selected_col_ym <<- prop("y", as.symbol(input$yAxism))
    df <- observed.data.frame
    df
  })
  
  sec_data <- reactive({    
    selected_col_xs <<- prop("x", as.symbol(input$xAxiss))
    selected_col_ys <<- prop("y", as.symbol(input$yAxiss))
    df <- observed.data.frame
    df
  })
  
  selected_data <- reactive({
    df <- sec_data()
    df <- df[lb$selected(),]
    df 
  })
  
  lb <- linked_brush(keys = observed.data.frame$id, "red")

  vism <- reactive({main_data() %>%
                    ggvis(x = selected_col_xm, y = selected_col_ym) %>%
layer_points(fill.brush := "red") %>%

lb$input()
                  })

  viss <- reactive({selected_data() %>% 
                    ggvis(x = selected_col_xs, y = selected_col_ys) %>%

layer_points()
                  })
  
  vism %>% bind_shiny("ggvis_scatm")
  viss %>% bind_shiny("ggvis_scats")
})

Now everything works perfectly except one feature: when the x and y input (input$xAxism and input$yAxism) for the main plot (vism) changes, the linked brush "disappears" - from this point until the restart of the application the selected data does not appear on the secondary plot (viss) again. I think it is because the app completely rebuild the plot because it is in a reactive function.

Is there any way to solve this problem keeping the linked brush in use, or I have to try something else?

Any help or advice would be highly appreciated.
Gergo

Don't put the plot in a reactive? Now that you're creating a reactive
dataset, this should be unnecessary.

You should also be able to refactor your code to remove any use of
<<-. It seems like you want something like:

selected_col_xm <- reactive({
prop("x", as.symbol(input$xAxism))
})

? Then you can delete both main_data() and sec_data(), which always
return the same value.

Hadley

parts:
Hi,

I've managed to make it work. It's a bit ugly, but it works.

UI
observed.data.frame <- mtcars
shinyUI(fluidPage(
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      uiOutput("main_ui"),

selectInput("xAxiss",
                  label = "Select the value of axis x for the secondary plot",
                  colnames(observed.data.frame)),
      selectInput("yAxiss",
                  label = "Select the value of axis y for the secondary plot",

colnames(observed.data.frame)),
      selectInput("sec_plot_type",
                  label = "Select the type of the secondary plot",
                  c("Scatter" = "scat", "Line" = "path", "Histogram" = "hist"))

),
    mainPanel(
      ggvisOutput("ggvis_scatm"),
      ggvisOutput("ggvis_scats")
    )
  )
))
SERVER

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  
  observed.data.frame <- mtcars
  observed.data.frame$id <- seq(1,length(observed.data.frame[,1]))
  
  lb <- linked_brush(keys = observed.data.frame$id, "red")

selected_col_xs <- reactive({ prop("x", as.symbol(input$xAxiss)) })
  selected_col_ys <- reactive({ prop("y", as.symbol(input$yAxiss)) })

input_mx <- input_select(colnames(observed.data.frame), label = "Select the value of axis x for the main plot", map = as.name)
  input_my <- input_select(colnames(observed.data.frame), label = "Select the value of axis y for the main plot", map = as.name)

selected_data <- reactive({
      observed.data.frame[lb$selected(),]
  })

  
  vism <- reactive({
                    observed.data.frame %>%

ggvis(x = input_mx, y = input_my) %>%
                    add_axis("x", title = "x") %>%
                    add_axis("y", title = "y") %>%

layer_points(fill.brush := "red") %>%
                    lb$input()
                  })
  
  
  viss <- reactive({

switch(input$sec_plot_type,
             scat = {

selected_data() %>%
                    ggvis(x = selected_col_xs()$value, y = selected_col_ys()$value) %>%
                    layer_points()

},
            path = {

selected_data() %>%
                ggvis(x = selected_col_xs()$value, y = selected_col_ys()$value) %>%

layer_paths()
            },
            hist = {

selected_data() %>%
                ggvis(x = selected_col_xs()$value, y = selected_col_ys()$value) %>%

layer_histograms()
            })
                  })
  

  vism %>% bind_shiny("ggvis_scatm", "main_ui")
  viss %>% bind_shiny("ggvis_scats", "sec_ui")

})

Thank you for the help.

G

parts:
Try this:

library(shiny)
library(ggvis)

print(shinyApp(

shinyUI(fluidPage(
sidebarLayout(
sidebarPanel(
uiOutput("main_ui"),

selectInput("main_x", "Main X axis", colnames(mtcars)),
selectInput("main_y", "Main Y axis", colnames(mtcars)),
selectInput("sub_x", "Sub X axis", colnames(mtcars)),
selectInput("sub_y", "Sub X axis", colnames(mtcars))
),
mainPanel(
ggvisOutput("main"),
ggvisOutput("sub")
)
)
)),
function(input, output, session) {
mtcars$id <- seq_along(mtcars[[1]])
lb <- linked_brush(keys = mtcars$id, "red")

selected <- reactive({
mtcars[lb$selected(),]
})

main_x <- reactive(as.symbol(input$main_x))
main_y <- reactive(as.symbol(input$main_y))
sub_x <- reactive(as.symbol(input$sub_x))
sub_y <- reactive(as.symbol(input$sub_y))

mtcars %>%
ggvis(x = main_x, y = main_y) %>%
layer_points(fill.brush := "red") %>%

lb$input() %>%
bind_shiny("main")

selected %>%
ggvis(x = sub_x, y = sub_y) %>%
layer_points() %>%
bind_shiny("sub", "sec_ui")
}
))

Important things to note:

* You should never wrap a ggvis object inside a reactive - ggvis knows
how to handle reactives so you should pass them directly to ggvis. I
do that with both the selected data, and the variable selection.

* I moved all variable selection code into one place - I wasn't sure
if this was important to your problem or not, but it sure was
confusing.

* Usually, you don't need to assign ggvis plots to variables - you can
bind directly to shiny.

Hadley
